title: Cubans Aren’t Sleeping in Sweltering Blackouts
summary_full: Our reporter Jack Nicas visits a sweltering Cuba where, six months into the Trump administration’s oil blockade, people struggle to sleep with no electricity for fans or air-conditioning.
